2608.11114.title: Two-stage Odd Residual Flows for Mean-Preserving Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
2608.11114.paper_summary: Probabilistic forecasting plays an essential role in risk-sensitive decision-making, particularly in long-horizon settings. However, existing approaches often face a fundamental trade-off between distributional flexibility and accurate mean prediction. Traditional parametric methods, such as Mean Variance Estimation (MVE), can suffer from degraded point accuracy when trained under joint Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) objectives, while modern-flexible generative models, including Normalizing Flows and Diffusion Models, typically rely on costly Monte Carlo sampling and may yield suboptimal mean estimates. To address this limitation, we propose Two-stage Odd Residual Flows (TORF), a framework that decouples mean forecasting from uncertainty estimation. In the first stage, a pre-trained deterministic model is used to produce an accurate mean prediction. In the second stage, a Restricted Normalizing Flow, with strictly odd functions learns flexible residual distributions around the point forecast, guaranteeing mean preservation from the first stage without sampling. Experiments show that TORF achieves state-of-the-art deterministic accuracy (NMAE) while providing strong density estimation performance (CRPS) on short and long-horizon forecasting.
2608.11114.paper_summary_zh: 概率預測在風險敏感的決策中扮演著重要角色，特別是在長期預測的情境中。<lb/>然而，現有的方法通常面臨分佈靈活性與準確均值預測之間的根本權衡。<lb/>傳統的參數方法，如均值方差估計（MVE），在聯合負對數似然（NLL）目標下訓練時，可能會導致點預測的準確性下降，而現代靈活的生成模型，包括正規化流和擴散模型，通常依賴昂貴的蒙特卡羅抽樣，並可能產生次優的均值估計。<lb/>為了解決這一限制，我們提出了兩階段奇異殘差流（TORF），這是一個將均值預測與不確定性估計解耦的框架。<lb/>在第一階段，使用預訓練的確定性模型來產生準確的均值預測。<lb/>在第二階段，受限正規化流，使用嚴格的奇函數學習圍繞點預測的靈活殘差分佈，保證第一階段的均值在不進行抽樣的情況下得到保留。<lb/>實驗表明，TORF在短期和長期預測中達到了最先進的確定性準確性（NMAE），同時提供了強大的密度估計性能（CRPS）。
